concern_results.conclusion: Traced both attack surfaces end to end. Classifier input: the extraction reads only top-level events whose type is "error" or ends in ".failed", pulling message or error.message, so the item-nested model-authored fixture (quota_in_model_output) cannot reach the quota/auth predicates — verified in the diff and backed by a mutation that removes the restriction; the residual generality of the ".failed" glob has no demonstrated carrier of model-influenced text into a top-level error.message. Stored excerpt: there is none — transport_diagnostic is the constant "the transport output for this failure is in transport_run_dir", so no credential-shaped, query-string, home-path, or packet-derived text can survive a redaction that no longer exists, the 600-byte/single-line bounds hold trivially, and the constant cannot mask a real diagnostic because the real streams survive in the preserved 0700 run directory named by transport_run_dir; the remaining path elision compares physical paths on both sides and rejects a separator-only HOME, with direct (non-helper) tests for the trailing-slash and HOME=/ cases. The placeholder cannot appear on a success path because emit_inconclusive only adds the key when the sixth argument is non-empty and only the run_rc!=0 call sites pass it, asserted by the pass row. Reason codes, classifier order, gate membership, exit codes, and all pre-existing call sites are byte-identical in behaviour (new positionals default to empty); grep simply reads a second, always-created file.

The shared-gate failure semantics are the exercised boundary: quota/provider_unavailable cascade, unknown_client_failure stops the lane, and the change only lets the transport's own top-level wording reach that decision — CANDIDATE_LOCAL_CODES is untouched and review_gate.py relays the new keys without interpreting them. Containment is executed rather than asserted: event-stream classification rows (usage_limit_event, usage_limit_turn_failed, auth_event) fail if extraction dies, the packet-derived-text guard rows red under the top-level-restriction mutation, and the constant-equality invariant replaces unprovable shape-absence assertions, with fixtures assembling credential shapes at runtime so no scanner trips on tracked data. The evidence-destruction defect is closed at its root (PRESERVE_RUN_ROOT gates the EXIT trap) rather than by copying excerpts into a committed artifact. The residual that a future CLI could surface tool-derived text in a top-level *.failed error.message is the one widening worth watching, but no current event carries model-influenced content there, so it does not meet the concrete-failure-path bar.
